coverage.name: Elbert County
limitations: The county's only posted 2026 sample ballot ("2026 SAMPLE BALLOT.pdf", one two-page style, PDF modified 2026-09-30) is image-only: its only searchable text is the "SAMPLE BALLOT" watermark. Because this page treats a scanned ballot as unreadable, no conclusion is drawn from it (checked 2026-10-10).

The Elections page posts no TABOR notice, ballot-content certification or participating-entities list. Its other 2026 General documents are the logic and accuracy test notice, voter instructions and the state Ballot Blue Book (checked 2026-10-10).

Leads only, for further review: the page images show no Elbert County question. The local ballot issues shown are Douglas County School District RE-1 Ballot Issue 5A and Elbert Fire Protection District Ballot Issue 7B. A text-readable ballot or the TABOR notice is needed to close this row.

coverage.name: Kiowa (town)
limitations: Rechecked 2026-10-12: the Elbert County Elections page posts the same image-only "2026 SAMPLE BALLOT.pdf" (image-only, modified 2026-09-30, no searchable text beyond the watermark), the logic and accuracy test notice, voter instructions and the Ballot Blue Book. No TABOR notice, ballot-content certification or participating-entities list is posted, and no such document appears among the county's newer Document Center uploads (IDs 5757 to 5767, all non-election items). Because this page treats a scanned ballot as unreadable, no conclusion is drawn from the sample ballot; read for leads only, it has no Town of Kiowa section.

Town Election page rechecked 2026-10-12: it still describes the November 5, 2024 General Election and says "Regular Town elections are coordinated with the County and held every 2 years during even-numbered years." It posts nothing for November 3, 2026. The Agendas and Minutes page and the home page post no 2026 election notice (newest home-page news items are dated September 2026 and concern Town Hall concepts and a mural).

Because the town says its regular elections are coordinated with the county in even-numbered years, a Kiowa contest or question on the November 2026 ballot is possible, and only a text-readable county ballot, TABOR notice or entity list can settle it. Left at official_notice_unavailable (checked 2026-10-12): no participating-entities list and no town election page or notice to read.
